**Create:** `overrides/app/components/ui-kits/organisms/zimmProductCard/acCoverage/index.stories.tsx`, Storybook title `'Commerce/ZimmProductCard/AC Coverage'`.

Read `overrides/app/components/ui-kits/organisms/zimmProductCard/nodeCoverage/index.stories.tsx` first in full — match its conventions exactly: same `Meta`/`StoryObj` typing, same `MemoryRouter` + width-`Box` decorator pattern (it exports a `widthDecorator(width: string)` helper you should copy or replicate identically), same base fixture shape for `HOME_BASE`/`PLP_BASE`/`WISHLIST_BASE`-style constants (id, name, headingLevel, href, primaryImage, hoverImage, currentPrice, badge, etc.) — but per Marcel's own recent decision, do NOT import shared fixtures from any extracted file; define the image/size data locally in this new file (small, local `PRIMARY_IMAGE`/`HOVER_IMAGE`/`GALLERY_IMAGES`/`SIZES` consts at the top, same values `nodeCoverage`'s own local area uses — copy them, don't reference another file).

For every story where the AC is about **hover** or **size-chip selection**, make it genuinely interactive the same way `zimmProductCard/index.stories.tsx`'s own `Default` story is (a local `useState`-backed wrapper around `selectedSizeChipValue`/`onSizeChipSelect`, so Marcel can actually click/hover and see it work, not a frozen static frame) — copy that exact pattern into this new file too (another accepted, deliberate duplication, matching the precedent already set for `nodeCoverage`'s own copy).

**Every story's `name` field must quote the literal AC text** (or a close paraphrase if too long) so Marcel can read which AC he's confirming directly in the Storybook sidebar/toolbar, and each story's own doc comment should state exactly what to look for / what action to take (e.g. "hover the card to check X").

Build these 21 stories, in this exact order, matching this exact numbering in each export name (`Core_AC1`, `PLP_AC1`...`PLP_AC5`, etc.):

**Core (2)**
- `Core_AC1` — "primary product image is always displayed regardless of variation." Render three cards side by side (Home, PLP, Wishlist — each minimal/default props) in one story so the same primary image is visibly present in all three at a glance.
- `Core_AC2` — "renders correctly without page-specific logic embedded in the component itself." Render one plain PLP card with no special setup beyond the file's own standard decorator. Doc comment: this component takes only props (no data-fetching hook, no page import) — the fact it renders correctly in Storybook's isolated environment, with zero page context beyond the router this story-file's own decorator supplies for the internal `Link`, is itself the demonstration.

**PLP (5)**
- `PLP_AC1` — default state: image, name, badge, price, cart icon visible. `variation:'plp'`, badge set, no hover needed.
- `PLP_AC2` — hover: size selector visible, price disappears, image switches to model photo. Interactive (real state), `hoverImage` set. Doc comment: hover the card to check all three happen together.
- `PLP_AC3` — hover: arrows appear. `images` set to a 3-image gallery so arrows have something to page through. Doc comment: hover to check arrows appear.
- `PLP_AC4` — mobile: size selector not displayed. Use the 179px `widthDecorator`. Doc comment: confirm no size-chip UI appears anywhere, including if you try clicking/hovering.
- `PLP_AC5` — out of stock: cart greyed out, notify-me appears on hover instead of price. `isUnavailable:true`, `onNotifyMe` set. Doc comment must state plainly, honestly: on desktop this is currently additive (price stays visible, notify-me joins it) rather than a literal swap — matches the shipped design, not the literal AC wording; flagged to Marcel separately. Don't soften or hide this in the comment.

**Home (4)**
- `Home_AC1` — default: image and name only. `variation:'home'`.
- `Home_AC2` — hover: arrows appear. `images` gallery set.
- `Home_AC3` — hover: price appears. Interactive/hoverable, `currentPrice` set.
- `Home_AC4` — mobile: user only sees image and name. 179px decorator. Doc comment must state plainly: the actual shipped behaviour also shows price on mobile (matches Figma, contradicts this AC's literal text) — this story renders the real shipped behaviour as-is so Marcel can see the discrepancy himself, not a hypothetical "what the AC says" mockup.

**Wishlist (4)**
- `Wishlist_AC1` — default: image, cart icon, name, colour, size, badge, price. `variation:'wishlist'`, `colour`/`size`/`badge` all set.
- `Wishlist_AC2` — remove ('x') CTA top right. Same as AC1's setup; doc comment points at the visible close/remove overlay top-right of the image.
- `Wishlist_AC3` — hover: image swaps to model photo. Interactive, `hoverImage` set.
- `Wishlist_AC4` — hover: arrows appear. `images` gallery set.

**Recently Viewed Full History (5) — own stories, same `variation:'plp'` code path as PLP, not aliased**
- `RecentlyViewed_AC1` through `RecentlyViewed_AC5` — same content/setup as `PLP_AC1` through `PLP_AC5` respectively, each with its own doc comment noting "same code path as PLP_ACn — this variation has no dedicated code, `variation:'plp'` is used for it per the ticket's own ACs."

**Extensibility (1)**
- `Extensibility_AC1` — "a new style can be configured without restructuring the base component." Not a visual AC — render the three existing variations (Home/PLP/Wishlist) side by side again (can reuse `Core_AC1`'s composition or a similar one). Doc comment should point at the real proof: `VARIATION_CONFIG` in `index.tsx` (a plain data table keyed by variation, zero `switch`/`if` on `props.variation` anywhere in the render body — verifiable via `grep -n "variation ==="`), and the two `@ts-expect-error` compile-time cases in `index.test.tsx` that prove the type system enforces per-variation field requirements. This story exists so Marcel has something to look at, but the real evidence is the cited code, not this render.

**Do not touch** `nodeCoverage/index.stories.tsx`, `index.stories.tsx`, or any component/recipe file — this is a new, additive Storybook file only.

When done, report the full list of 21 story export names as actually written, confirm `npx tsc --noEmit` is clean, and confirm nothing else in the repo was touched (`git status --short`). Do not stage, do not commit — Marcel will review this in Storybook himself first.
